case_name: Stark Research Labs — Timothy Dungan Insider/APT (2012)
source_dataset: SANS FIND EVIL Hackathon 2026 — Rob T. Lee corpus
description: Timothy Dungan (tdungan), employee of Stark Research Labs, domain SHIELDBASE, authenticated via RDP from FALCONIII (10.3.98.10) at 18:20 EST on 2012-04-02. SeDebugPrivilege assigned at logon. SAM credential dump via lsass.exe at 20:50. Password-protected ZIP evading AV. Dropbox active as exfiltration vector. APT1 IOCs present in Redline analysis.
devil_advocate: Privileged token assignments are standard domain policy for IT staff; SAM access is routine LSASS operation; password-protected ZIP is a personal tax document

artifacts.description: Event 528: tdungan RDP logon to WKS-WINXP32BIT from FALCONIII (10.3.98.10) via RDP-Tcp#9. Logon type 10 (RemoteInteractive). Auth: Negotiate.

metadata.anomaly: RDP lateral movement after-hours; RemoteInteractive logon type from non-primary workstation

artifacts.description: Event 576: Special privileges assigned to tdungan at logon: SeDebugPrivilege, SeBackupPrivilege, SeRestorePrivilege, SeChangeNotifyPrivilege.

metadata.anomaly: SeDebugPrivilege enables LSASS memory read and credential dumping. Combination with SeBackupPrivilege allows SAM hive access bypassing ACLs. Canonical mimikatz/pwdump prerequisite.

artifacts.description: Event 560/562 (Records 90242-90245): Two sequential SAM_SERVER object open/close sequences via lsass.exe (PID 1076) at 20:50:21 EST. Handle IDs 882888 and 955648. Access mask 0x62835816.

metadata.anomaly: Two independent SAM_SERVER handles opened in same second via lsass. Access mask includes GENERIC_READ over SAM. 150-minute gap from SeDebugPrivilege assignment suggests deliberate delay to evade real-time monitoring.

artifacts.description: McAfee scan failure: password-protected 2011-W2.zip containing 2011-W2.pdf blocked AV engine. Dropbox shellext created in tdungan profile at 18:20:26 EST (same minute as RDP logon).

metadata.anomaly: Password-protected ZIP blocks AV — documented APT1 TTP for evading endpoint detection. Dropbox initialized at same minute as RDP logon suggests pre-staged exfiltration channel.

artifacts.description: TermDD Event 50: WARNING Device\Termdd DATA ENCRYPTION anomaly at 20:05:39 EST during active RDP session. Gmail (dungantimothy@gmail.com, 7 inbox messages) accessed via Firefox at 19:13 EST. APT1 IOC match in Redline .mans.

metadata.anomaly: TermDD DATA ENCRYPTION warning indicates RDP cipher negotiation failure or downgrade — consistent with RDP interception or non-standard client. Gmail accessed from corporate host during same session as credential dumping. APT1 IOC confirmed.

peirce_expected.firstness: RDP lateral movement from FALCONIII with SeDebugPrivilege assigned at logon; SAM_SERVER accessed via lsass 150 minutes later; password-protected ZIP blocking AV; Dropbox initialized at logon time
peirce_expected.secondness: 150-minute gap between privilege assignment and SAM dump is deliberate evasion; TermDD encryption anomaly during active RDP session; personal Gmail accessed from corporate host in same window; APT1 IOC match in memory
peirce_expected.thirdness: Timothy Dungan used RDP lateral movement to access WKS-WINXP32BIT, obtained SeDebugPrivilege to dump SAM credentials, packaged exfiltrated data in a password-protected ZIP to evade AV, and used Dropbox as a passive cloud exfiltration channel — consistent with APT1-assisted insider credential theft at Stark Research Labs
